content: Tauri v2 architecture uses a Rust core with webview rendering via WRY/TAO. IPC is command-based (#[tauri::command] macro) with JSON serialization via serde. State management uses tauri::State<T> for dependency injection. Plugins extend functionality (global-shortcut, clipboard-manager, etc). System tray uses TrayIconBuilder with menu and event handling. Frontend invokes Rust via invoke() function.
